page_title: BET 2-2 SEV | Betis v Sevilla 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Ricardo De Burgos has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+3' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

90+1' Akor Adams (Sevilla) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' That will be all from Djibril Sow who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Batista Mendy (Sevilla).
90' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).

87' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the left post and ricochets away.
85' Yellow card! It's like Isaac Romero (Sevilla) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Ricardo De Burgos agrees and books him.
85' 2 - 2 What a goal! Djibril Sow plays it to Isaac Romero (Sevilla), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Alvaro Valles into the left side of the goal. 2:2.
85' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Sevilla.
83' One of the players from Sevilla times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Natan (Betis) was quite harsh and Ricardo De Burgos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Antony (Betis) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Sevilla will take a free kick near the side line.
80' Kike Salas (Sevilla) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Betis.
78' The attendance for today's match is 67447.
77' Alvaro Valles pulls off a great save to deny Akor Adams (Sevilla), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
75' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
75' Diego Llorente (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo De Burgos had an easy-decision to make.
74' Matias Almeyda prepares a substitution. Cesar Azpilicueta is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla).
72' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Cedric Bakambu (Betis) coming on for Cucho Hernandez.
70' Matias Almeyda decides to make a substitution. Alexis Sanchez will be replaced by Isaac Romero (Sevilla).
70' Substitution. Alvaro Fidalgo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
64' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) commits a foul during an attacking move. A free kick is awarded to Betis.
62' 2 - 1 Goal! Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) makes the score 2:1 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Oso.
60' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
59' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

59' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Oso (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Betis will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
56' A dangerous looking corner kick from Pablo Fornals (Betis) is cleared to safety by the defence.
56' Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
54' The game is interrupted now, Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
51' Oso (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alvaro Valles, who smothers the ball.
49' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
48' Oso (Sevilla) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Betis earn a free kick.
47' Referee Ricardo De Burgos sees the trip by Alvaro Fidalgo (Betis) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Sevilla have a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Matias Almeyda decided to make a change. Jose Angel Carmona is replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
46' The game is over for Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla). Oso comes on for the second half.
46' Referee Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' The resulting corner, taken by Pablo Fornals (Betis), comes to nothing.
45+3' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Poor challenge! Kike Salas (Sevilla) is penalised for tripping and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle. Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
42' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.
37' 2 - 0 Goal! Abde Ezzalzouli tees up Alvaro Fidalgo (Betis) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 2:0.
33' What a sweet touch by Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Alvaro Valles to hold.
31' Diego Llorente (Betis) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Sevilla win a free kick.
28' Diego Llorente (Betis) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
26' Diego Llorente (Betis) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Antony (Betis) for his blatant foul.

24' A short pass finds Akor Adams (Sevilla) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.

22' Alvaro Valles makes a brilliant save! Akor Adams (Sevilla) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the left side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
20' Sevilla enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
16' 1 - 0 GOAL! Antony (Betis) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 1:0.
16' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
15' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul. Betis are awarded a free kick.
14' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is behind the touchline and Betis will take a throw-in.
12' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) will miss the next game.
11' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Ricardo De Burgos and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
9' Betis are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
8' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Betis will take a free kick.
7' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) brings his opponent down. Ricardo De Burgos has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Betis are awarded the free kick.
7' Kike Salas (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Ricardo De Burgos signals a set piece. That's a free kick to Betis.
6' The corner from Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) is hurriedly cleared.
4' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
4' Ricardo De Burgos interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aitor Ruibal (Betis). Sevilla have a free kick.

2' A clever short pass gives Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ricardo De Burgos.
